name: Reka AI
desc: Natively multimodal models for text, image, video, audio
desc_zh: 同一架构处理文本、图像、视频与音频的多模态模型
solves: One architecture for text, image, video and audio — no adapter layer, no per-modality prompt format. Reka Cloud trains and deploys it; the models are enterprise.
solves_zh: 文本、图像、视频、音频共用一套架构，不用为每种模态另写适配层和提示格式。Reka Cloud 负责训练部署，模型仅对企业开放。
best_for: A request that mixes modalities and needs one reasoning pass, at enterprise terms.
best_for_zh: 当一次请求混合多种模态却只想推理一遍，而且接受企业级条件。
